balls.text: Dhoni ends it in style. He gets down on one knee, that's a clean stroke over mid-wicket and it's gone a long way. Thwack.
pulled to deep square leg, just the one
Down town - as Danny says - that was big. Albie has gone straight back over Jadeja's head, hits it hard and high and it's gone all the way
gets one away, nudged through mid wicket
outside off, Dhoni makes too much room and can't get to the ball in the end
Jadeja bowling the final over, Dhoni wants to smack this on the leg sode, and misses
driven to long on, Dhoni seems to have tweaken something, he is hobbling a little
wide and driven hard to cover. Mahela is down quickly and saves a certain four
gets it off the toe end to cover
low full toss, Dhoini swings off the back foot and sends that crashing through mid-wicket
full but Albie makes contact, drives on the off side

it's all happening here. Great ball, full, and difficult to get away, Raina misses and wants the bye. Attempted run out from the keeper with an underarm throw, the bowler has a second go, hits the stumps and Raina is out.
full and dug out, Dhoni pushed on the off side, where RP does his own fielding and almost orchestrates a run out but misses, fine over
short ball, Dhoni wants to pull but can't make contact
width offered and Raina makes some room but gets it down to long off, it was in the air for a while and Raina gets 50
dinky little shot to short fine leg, off the inside edge, we've seen a lot of runs scored there
touch shorter, Dhoni rocks back and drives off the back foot to mid-on but can't get it too far
bounce on offer for RP still, Dhoni wants to cut that, maybe even helicopter it, and misses
edged and four. Lucky again as that misses the stumps and races to fine leg
first six of the innings and it's a bludgeon. Raina rocks back and sends that sailing over mid wicket
slower ball again, played to short third man
smacked to deep cover, hit with great urgency, looking for two, turned down

Badri wants to improvise, by going for a biggie on the leg side, trying to flick it over fine leg, but he's chosen the wrong shot. It's hit the pad, absolutely plumb in front of middle and leg and there was no hesitation in giving that out.
slower ball, neatly picked up and flicked to long on
full again, but wider. Badri reaches for it, and gets it as far as extra cover
full and driven to mid-off, Raina can't get it away as he'd like to
slower ball, smacked to long-on
full toss, Raina is swinging but gets it as far as mid-on
full delivery, chooped out to deep backward point
lucky, Badri reached out for that, was deceived by the change of pace and one-handedly scooped that to cover. Escapes being caught
full toss, smacked to long on, decent over from Powar
looking for a big sweep, but Badri can only get a bit of bat on it to trickle away to fine leg
in the block hole, dug out to long off, no boundary yet this over
driven in the air to long-off. good, hard running for two
driven down to long-on
tossed up again, played to cover
aerial! Raina mistimes that to long-off who can't get there in time to take the catch
crunched through the covers
bouncer, follows Badri who can't get it away
down to third man, Badri gets a delicate touch on that and guides it down with an angled bat
powerful pull shot, Raina looking to go over mid-wicket but the ball runs along the ground and it's just one
full toss, driven back to Vinay who cleans up off his own bowling
driven down to long-off, Badri runs hard but Raina ambles through and it's just one
cut almost off the 'keeper's gloves, straight to the fielder at point
clipped to mid-wicket, Badri sets off straight away, good fielding keeps it down to one
driven again, on the on-side, tame shot and there's no run there
driven on the on-side, just wide of the bowler
Gomez starts for real this time and Raina gets an inside egde on that, misses legstump and runs down to fine leg, Ramesh Powar can't get to it
dropped  Badri gets an outside edge to short third man, Hodge is there and had to move to his right to take it. He leapt at the right time, got some fingers to it and put it down.
on the leg stump line, nudged into the leg side, thoughts of a second, not taken
tossed up again, pushed through the covers
coming over the wicket and Raina dances down the pitch, drives to long-on
straighter and swept through mid-wicket, Raina makes good contact with that one
tossed up, hit on the up too and McCallum at short extra cover could have taken a superb catch, RP cleans up in the deep
run down to fine leg, slower delivery
superb timing, played down between square leg and mid-wicket and there's a big gap there
outside egde, beats Jaya at point, third man cuts it off
Leaves that one alone, it's wide outside off and doesn't need touching
appeal and given! Full delivery, strikes Vijay on the front pad as he looks to turn that to the leg-side and misses, plumb in front, that was hitting middle and leg.
played down to deep square leg
slightly short, guided to point, fielder cleans up
looking to toss it up again, driven with some force to long-off. Powar had no chance this time, even though it was hit past him
played back to Powar, who fields off his bowling. Jackman has just hinted at Powar;s weight, saying "doesn't make all the training sessions". That was athletic
driven to long on
decent fielding again in the covers, not as full from Powar this time
tossed up, driven to short extra cover, McCallum fields excellently to prevent a run
that one didn't bounce. Danny suggests a change of pace and it ends the over without a run
not as full, Vijay on one knee this time, caresses that through that covers, sublime
driven so sweetly through the covers. Full ball, inviting the shot and Vijay isn't going to let those ones go. Beautiful timing
little inside edge to mid-wicket
excellent delivery, jags away from the outside edge, Raina looking to turn on the on side, misses
defended back to the bowler
starts with a wide, just brushes past the leg side, an appeal, as happens in this case
bouncer, takes off from back of a length and Vijay has to move out of the way to let the keeper take that
better line and length and defended into the covers
ooof! frustration for RP. Vijay gets an inside edge, just misses the off stump and races away for four
great timing on that, little bit of width offered and Vijay pushes into the gap behind square on the off side, classy shot
slightly shorter and turned around to mid-wicket
Not too mcuh wrong with that ball, Raina makes some room for himself and hits that down the ground to long off
worked to mid-wicket, quick single taken and Raina keeps strike
cut away, beats the man in the circle and is fielded at third man
smack! Vijay picks that up from just outside off and pulls with power over mid-wicket
pushed onto the on-side, good running
short, but Raina can;t get it away, mistimes the pull shot
outside edge again, goes down to third man, small misfield, but kept down to one
good line again, defended solidly, impressive over from RP
touch shorter, good shape, moves away and left alone
RP bowling a good line, keeping it tight, nothing to do but defend
defended on the back foot away to the off side
RP Singh has his first wicket of the 2011 IPL. Good movement again, Hussey gets a top edge and he's on his way
turned away down to fine leg
drifted down the leg side
good length again and defended into the covers, good start for Vinay
great movement, moved across the left-hander
defended on the back foot, pushed to point and Hussey wants one, but Vijay sends him back
outside edge, flies off the bat and runs down to third man quickly, there's a man there so that keeps it down to one
good length, Vijay defends solidly on the front foot
movement as well, that goes away from Vijay although it swung after going past the batsman, left alone
best ball of the over, bit of movement again, Hussey looks to play down to that third man area but is beaten
touch shorter again, Hussey defends on the back foot
too classy from Hussey, RP bowls a good length and Hussey plays with such delicacy, guides it past third man
much better from RP, Hussey defends back to him
short, wide and cut away, that beats the fielder at third man and it's the first boundary
a touch of bounce, a little bit of away movement, Hussey wafts at it and the 'keeper and slip go up, way too hopeful

and now it is a first home victory for Kochi. The roar from the crowd says how much this means. Worked off the backfoot and strong running sees Jadeja come back for the second with ease after a poor throw from the deep
Jadeja wants to finish it like a superstar and he is. Gets under the ball and send its sailing over deep mid-wicket. Mahela claps from the dug out and it's almost a first home victory
played to the left of Ashwin, no room for a run
steered to point and good run taken
bit of bounce from Ashwin, easy again, through the covers
eased past mid on
full and straight, driven to mid on
better length, worked away to third man
up, up and away. Short and slapped over long-on. Pressure released
that is wayward, banged in short and down the leg-side
width on offer, bashed into the covers and sets off for the run quickly, stumps are broken but he is comfortably home
picked up beautifully, a powerful flick through the leg side and races to the mid wicket boundary
Hodge dancing all over the place. Southee keeps it outsie off, stays low and Hodge can't reach it
smashed straight to the man at deep mid wicket. Short and hittable, Patel rocks on his back foot but this one isn't going over the rope. Good knock from the ex Chennai man
bit of width offered and slapped down to deep cover
full and driven out to the man in the deep, no risks from Patel, none needed
bouncer, Patel moves out of the way just at the right moment
waits for it well, cut down to third man
pulled away off the hips, Bollinger goes for a shorter ball and its good for Hodge to ignore
strikes Patel on the pads, big appeal, might have pitched outside leg
whipped off the back foot through square leg
almost a run out. Parthiv Patel wants the run and is halfway down the pitch, the throw isnt accurate but the bat was in the air and he would've been gone
guides it down to short third man
that's a biggie. Patel is down on one knee and smashes it over deep mid-wicket
Steers it down to third man, reverse sweep, smart thinking from the Aussie
pushed to mid off
defended back to Ashwin
nudged on the leg side

not quite down town this time. McCullum goes down the wicket and plays it high. This time he hasn't got all that much on it and Albie Morkel takes the catch at long off. In 2008, on this day, McCullum scored 158 not out. Nothing similar today
almost identical from all sides, straight ball, defended
straight delivery and defended back to Ashwin
tries to do it again but misses this time
one bounce four, sweeps with such timing, splits the men at deep mid wicket and deep square leg
turned on the leg side
picked up outside off and flciked to deep mid wicket
driven to long on
McCullum sweeps this time, Hussey makes good ground at fine leg and saves a couple
slower, yorker length and pushed to mid on, McCullum keeps strike
even better, that one is in the gap at deep square leg, McCullum is pulling with such ease, MS can only stand and look on
deep mid wicket pulverished again. McCullum like thats area and he is going to keep sending the ball there
a near mess up from the fielder there at deep mid wicket. Pushed away with some force and the man gets away from the rop, only to lose it and almost see it bobble over
hit hard through the covers and Mike Hussey has work to do at long off, he slides in and saves four
on target this time, driven down past Southee to long on
splayed down the leg side, called wide
gets it a bit further, played out into the deep, just the one, but the end of a productive over.
pushed into the covers
turned to square leg
straight, straight, straight. McCullum goes high and over the bowler's head and gets the maximum
aerial and safe. Patel looks to hoick that over the leg-side, he is down on one knee but doesn't get hold of it and it lands safely in between long on and deep mid wicket
pushed to long off
More runs in the third man region. Comes off the toe end of the bat and beats a chasing fielder down to the rope.
quicker ball, tapped on the off side
driven to long off
leans on his backfoot and pulls along the ground to long on
pushed to short fine leg and Badri misfields
McCullum tries to reverse sweep from outside the line and misses, almost falls over trying
another boundary for Patel. Over the man at mid-off, good footwork from Patel
banged in short, Patel ducks
veering onto the leg stump line Patel wants to flick away, misses and then wants a bye, is sent back
overpitched and driven, sweet stroke through the off side, good timing, good placement, good result
what a ball. Nips back into Parthiv Patel and almost tickles off stump
flicked to deep backward square leg
just a nudge again, into the covers, Ashwin recovered remarkably well from the start of his over when he was bashed about
off the back foot, punched out to the covers
tucked him up and squeezed out to square leg
third time unlucky. Mahela looks for the big one again, and gets a leading edge and Anirudha comes in to take it at short cover
swept to fine leg, good timing on that shot, the fielder from deep backward square can't get there in time
Mahela takes advantage of no-one at long on, makes some room and hauls that over the rope
short and pulled with immense power. McCullum had very little time to act on that one but was on the back foot and set it screaming through mid wicket
inside edge and almost chops it on to the stumps, but it bounces over them
back and across and pushed into the off side for one
just a little full, Mahela goes wide of mid-on and there's enough for that for a few bounces and four
on a length and slapped back to Bollinger.
bounce on offer again. Short ball, rises on Mahela who can't connect for the pull
pushed into the covers, can't pierce the gap
low full toss, driven off the to end of the bat to mid on
outside edge and that goes past Dhoni and runs down to third man for four. There's been a lot of runs in that region in this match
looks to do it again, McCullum on one knee, wanting to pull but misses and Dhoni collects
MS comes up and that's better from Morkel, McCullum defends on the off side
ouch! McCullum doing the tango, down the pitch again, it's high and it's gone over long-on again. Length delivery and McCullum is in a mood
another one wide outside off, not given
picked up off the hips to fine leg

missed run out  Mahela would have been had Badri hit the stumps. It was played to the left of the bowler, Badri ran in from extra cover and got to it in good time but his under arm throw missed the stumps
angles it across Mahela, who looks to drive, but plays late and misses
full and wide outside off, Mahela thinks it wide, not given
and he takes a tumble in his follow through. It was back of a lengt and strikes McCullum on the hip, he wants to pull but misses, leg bye taken
flicked to mid-wicket, McCullum keeps strike
touch of width, wants to cut, but can't get it away
down town! McCullum charges down the wicket, smacks it over Morkel's head and long-on and he is off the mark
bang on target, superb line and length and McCullum can only defend
swing and a miss from Brendon, that was pretty close to offstump. Albie didn't slide this time
punched into the off side, it's packed with fielders and there's no chance of a run
